title: "Cell and Mutex for Shared State"

# Cell and Mutex for Shared State
- `Cell<T>`: Interior mutability for `Copy` types via value copying.
- `Mutex<T>`: Thread-safe interior mutability via mutual exclusion locks.

```rust
use std::sync::Mutex;

fn main() {
    let m = Mutex::new(0);
    {
        let mut guard = m.lock().unwrap();
        *guard += 1;
    }
    println!("Mutex protected value: {:?}", m.lock().unwrap());
}
```
